blocks.text: Love is sweeter the second time around for Katrina Halili and Kris Lawrence, as they revealed that they are officially back together. The couple confirmed their relationship status in the latest episode of their vlog, titled “It’s Official,” which was uploaded on Sunday, Sept. 27.
